summary: Carlyle Credit Solutions filed an 8-K reporting a routine private continuous offering issuance: 569,592 Class I shares for $10.3 million, about $18.08 per share, effective September 1, 2026, with final share count fixed September 17. NAV per share was $18.05 at August 31, 2026; aggregate NAV about $1.7 billion; Class I shares outstanding total 96,642,336. The board declared a $0.14 per-share cash dividend payable October 28 to holders of record September 30. No advisor, premium, or deal terms; watch subscription pacing and NAV-driven pricing rather than arbitrage.
